_note: Numbers in the manuscript that are not measurements, and why. The number check sets these aside from its binding count and lists each with the rule that set it aside. A rule matches by pattern on the printed paragraph or cell, so the same value printed as a result elsewhere is still checked. Heading numbers and cross-references to a heading are recognised without a rule. A rule with a `source` names the file that sets the value and a `defined_by` pattern that must still match there; if the code stops defining the value, the check fails.

rules.name: splice window
rules.reason: The proximal splice window and its core/region split are definitions of the analysis set.

rules.name: bootstrap resamples
rules.reason: Resample count of the gene-clustered and variant-level bootstraps.

rules.name: sampling-frame resamples
rules.reason: Resample count of the sampling-frame reweighting bootstrap.

rules.name: interval level
rules.reason: Every interval is a 95% percentile interval.

rules.name: ECE bins
rules.reason: Bin count of the expected calibration error.

rules.name: confidence band
rules.reason: The calibrated-confidence cut-offs that define a high-confidence call.

rules.name: operating point
rules.reason: The specificity at which every likelihood ratio is reported, fixed in advance.

rules.name: operating-point grid
rules.pattern: \b(90)%, (95)%, (97\.5)% and (99)% specificity|at (90)%, (97\.5)% and (99)% specificity|at (97\.5)% and (99)% specificity|at (97\.5)% specificity
rules.reason: The four specificities of the operating-point sensitivity analysis.

rules.name: evidence prior
rules.reason: The prior probability at which Tavtigian bands are applied.

rules.name: TP53 label rules
rules.reason: The three TP53 label definitions: control-anchored midpoint, median split, mid-band exclusion.

rules.name: reproduction tolerances
rules.reason: Tolerances asserted by the frozen-matrix-v2 reproduction tests.

rules.name: Tavtigian thresholds
rules.reason: Likelihood-ratio thresholds of the Tavtigian point system at a prior of 0.10.

rules.name: operating-point bounds
rules.pattern: sensitivity / (0\.05)|cannot exceed (20)\b|capped near (20)\b|sensitivity above (0\.93)\b|more than (93)% of true positives
rules.reason: Arithmetic of the operating point: 1 − 0.95 = 0.05; LR+ ≤ 1/0.05 = 20; Strong needs sensitivity ≥ 18.7 × 0.05 = 0.935.

rules.name: significance levels
rules.reason: Conventional significance levels named in the text, not estimates.

rules.name: TP53 assay scale
rules.pattern: anchored at (−1) for synonymous and (\+1) for nonsense
rules.reason: The published anchoring of the TP53 relative fitness score.

rules.name: companion atlas
rules.pattern: atlas's (46,392)-SNV matrix|stratifies (3)–(10), (11)–(50) and >(50) bp|the (11)–(50) bp band
rules.reason: Properties of the companion atlas's matrix and strata, reported in that study.

rules.name: label encoding
rules.reason: The binary label coding.

rules.name: audited offsets
rules.reason: Intron offsets naming audited variants.

rules.name: illustration
rules.reason: Numbers used to explain a definition, not results.

rules.name: dates
rules.reason: Calendar dates.

rules.name: repository name
rules.reason: Digits inside the repository name.

rules.reason: Digits inside MaveDB accessions.

rules.reason: Figure and table numbers.
